world_at_checkpoint_capture.instruction: Read the actual final world artifact. Do not rerun to chase PASS. A later append-only continuation must record either the complete success or the exact next failure.

verifier_dispatch.response_body: To use Codex here, [create an environment for this repo](https://chatgpt.com/codex/cloud/settings/environments).
verifier_dispatch.policy_note: A different real fresh Verifier context is permitted; this is not a requirement to use one specific cloud provider. No independent machine rerun is required by default for exact trusted repository-owned CI.

post_build_critique.unnecessary_complexity: One production bandwidth reset and a bounded six-ID test-client completion barrier; no new transport, timers, retry loop or owner.
post_build_critique.duplicate_truth: No Matter, Item Graph, persistence or replication truth is duplicated. Expected receipt IDs are derived only from the traffic this fixture already sends.
post_build_critique.implicit_owner: ENet host initialization stays with the existing adapter; deciding when to withdraw and detach stays with the EG4 test client.
post_build_critique.coupling_reduction: Use the existing host API on the pinned engine, without rebuilding the engine or changing channels, modes or adaptive RTT throttling.
post_build_critique.sibling_surface_fix: The adapter covers its server endpoints. EG4 was repaired only after an actual full-suite failure; original gateway/server workers and process assertions remain unchanged.
post_build_critique.removable_code: Unrelated unused fields are left alone. Negative controls and source-diff guards remain because timing-sensitive single PASS results did not prove either cause.
post_build_critique.design_regression: Missing, duplicate, injected, foreign-session, extra and malformed receipts cannot open the new barrier. The original deadline and all original traffic are preserved.
post_build_critique.refactor_if_redesigned: A generic acknowledgement framework is not justified for this bounded fixture and would add unneeded ownership and maintenance surface.
rank_up_moves: The temporary approved-engine seed artifact expires on 2026-09-14. Future reuse must supply the same pinned binary through a reviewed available channel; missing artifact or hash mismatch remains a hard failure.
